revisionReason: DESKTOP-SKIN: Desktop design system reskin, sidebar shell, keyboard-aware layout and typing performance. Live captions are display data, not completed user turns or tool arguments. Drafts and exact revisions arrive through completed Responses function items. Visible card buttons own sending and cancellation. Atomic historical startup context and on-demand readers replace continuous backlog injection.
fixtureCorrections: NATIVE-BOTTOM-INSET: removing the old tab bar left Settings and other scroll panes extending behind Android navigation. The shell now owns the raw native bottom inset once. In-pane composer, sticky Reader dock and pinned sidebar keep only their ordinary spacing, while fixed overlays retain their own native insets. Execute real ControlPanel scroll-end geometry plus shared transport geometry for portrait/gesture/landscape/IME viewports. A failed browser-import preflight is not regression evidence.

TTS-MIXING: pet, reply, Reader and Support speech used HTMLAudioElement on Android, leaving WebView in charge of audio focus. Android synthesis now uses a native MediaPlayer with speech attributes and no focus request or communication-route mutation. Execute bridge selection, clip identity, pause during preparation, resume, late cancellation, error and destruction checks. Mixing with another app still requires physical-device acceptance after installing the replacement APK. Live microphone/WebRTC leases remain separate.

MATH-FORMATTING: the shared Markdown renderer emitted raw LaTeX. Render inline/display math with bundled KaTeX fonts and untrusted commands disabled. Preserve code/link source and unfinished streaming expressions. Long display equations scroll within the message in portrait and landscape, never widening the page or hiding the composer.

REQUEST-CAPABILITY-HANDSHAKE: new hosts reject server questions until the connection advertises server_requests. The authenticated adapter sends client.capabilities before forwarding gateway.ready to installed phones, only once per connection, and consumes its own success or old-host error response. Tests execute ready ordering plus actual core approval, clarify, sudo and secret round trips without sending agent work.

FIRST-PROMPT-WIRE: execute session/share/settings/review builders through the real JSON-RPC serializer and profile mapper, then validate those frames and translated question responses against the host OpenRPC document. Generic Record return annotations had hidden preview from the static diagnostic. Creation preview is legacy metadata, never an implicit submitted/seeded message. Sudo's legacy password parameter maps to the core value result.

VOICE-NOTES-STARTUP: persistent user and target-session voice notes are supplied in startup instructions for Realtime and both GPT-Live roles. They are not historical dialogue to replay or execution authority. Whole redacted notes remain present, with profile/target isolation, before the first response.

RPC-PROFILE-CONTRACT: reconciliation must validate transport-added profile and helper/spread fields against the target host OpenRPC contract. check-gateway-contracts.mjs is a supplemental static diagnostic, not behavioral proof. Dispatched host tests and the live Controls request matrix cover profile reads, lazy sessions, config-write isolation, completion and voice handoff. Empty tool selection remains empty rather than enabling every row.

REQUEST-EXACT-ID: approval answers now retain the card's request ID and session owner. Overlapping cards can be answered out of order, cancellation retires only its matching card, and replay cannot duplicate or resurrect it. Late receipts cannot mark a different connection/session. Expired cards have no action controls and same-frame double presses are single-flight.

VOICE-CONTEXT-STATUS: an attached session preview is not a full transcript. The voice page now shows the attached title and attachment state, transcript depth from authoritative coverage, backend observedAt with Fresh/Aging/Stale state, and saved voice-memory availability from scoped recall. Short landscape keeps the status visible in one compact row without taking the transcript below its usable floor.

HOST-WORKSTATION-ROUTE: Cloud selection previously retired both local bridges, while a stale Desktop publication prevented recovery after returning to local. The route script now preserves a verified Workstation binding across Cloud and permits startup only with one validated local owner. Focused PowerShell route tests cover local/Cloud/local, ambiguity and malformed data. Host status distinguishes a waiting Desktop from unavailable backend/proxy. Physical Workstation chat reconnection was verified after supervisor replacement.

S9-KEYBOARD-PLAYBACK: native insets now subtract only space Android has not already excluded. Portrait keyboard resize no longer selects the landscape rail. Very short landscape retains transcript height by compacting static chrome. Speech balloons wait for a real playing event, ignore late cancelled media, and do not retrigger on resume. Voice transport-error regression now sends the preserved card, proving its session ownership survives.

S9-VOICE-RESULTS: large results now use lossless call-local tool pages, not synthetic user messages or an unbounded Live packet. HOOK-LARGE-READ and HOOK-GPT-LIVE-LARGE-RESULT reconstruct full evidence through the advertised read tool. Empty expectedDraft creates a new card while stale revisions stay rejected. Provider transport failures preserve the review and stop imaginary progress. Pet sprite painting keeps dimensions and decoded image stable across pose changes.

LIVE-PENDING-TOOLS: concurrent delegated responses previously continued independently. A fast UI tool could issue response.create while a held history read still owed its output. Both clients now track all outstanding tool results and active response lifecycles before issuing one continuation. HOOK-GPT-LIVE-PENDING-TOOLS fails with the previous sender and passes with the shared session barrier.

SUPPORT-REVIEW-CONCURRENCY: the real rendered review left editing and cancellation enabled during voice-owned dispatch. Shared submitting state now covers UI and voice, and a synchronous guard prevents same-task double dispatch. Accepted submission is retired before view refresh, whose failure cannot make the action available again. Fifteen real StrictMode rendered checks cover both racing paths, cancellation, target/host changes, dispatch errors and refresh errors.

SUPPORT-CARD-ONLY-APPROVAL: every Support proposal remains behind its visible editable card. Spoken yes, no, filler, corrections, and timing cannot submit or clear it. Only the card actions share the guarded dispatch path. The model gains no approval tool or Discord posting authority.

MOBILE-PROFILES-CRONS: selected host/profile scopes session routing, local persistence and native notification identity. The standalone block above Controls duplicated Scheduled work with mismatched typography and layout. Profile is now a normal collapsed Controls section, and the existing Scheduled work section owns profile scope, live running state, Run now, pause/resume, removal, progress, messages, saved output and creation.

UI-HEADER-POLISH: pill-shaped header controls crowded machine and profile into one truncating line, while text glyphs made Refresh and Close look optically off-center. Header status controls now use the project's rounded-square geometry and matched heights. Machine and profile occupy separate lines with the profile protected from the machine ellipsis. Header action glyphs use the same centered stroke SVG system and fixed square hit boxes.

HOST-VOICE-EVIDENCE: opt-in diagnostics now reach the authenticated selected host/profile. Real StrictMode hook checks cover transport/profile switches, opt-out, unmount and late callbacks. Upload payloads exclude transcripts, audio, secrets and customer text.

VOICE-NOISE-ASR-FLOOR: empty and arbitrary square-bracket labels are never treated as user speech. They preserve playback and pending reviews. Mixed input keeps all outside words, especially negation. No transcript, old or new, has approval authority. HOOK-016 still supplies a real stop transcript before expecting interrupted tool reads to stay silent.

VOICE-APPROVAL-LOOP: Replaced caption extraction, filler filters, quiet-period staging and opaque client delegation with the documented Live Responses tool loop. Collect complete function items through response.completed, return all function outputs, then one response.create. A structured draft is complete and editable. expectedDraft prevents stale or cross-target revisions, including while submitting or after cancel/send. User captions never approve or overwrite. Realtime retains its separate transport. Existing helper-only parser tests were testing the wrong authority and are replaced by real-hook structured-event checks.

VOICE-HISTORY-RECEIPT: the production pet.realtime.record RPC returns only the newly stored turn, not full history. The fixture now matches that contract. Refresh pet.sidechat.history and verify receipt membership before replacing the sidechat. VOICE-CURRENT-REVIEW-STATE: read tools expose current app-owned pending-review/submission state separately from historical receipts and identify the whole latest assistant message without mistaking tool activity for an answer or acceptance for completion.

VOICE-TRANSCRIPT-HANDOFF: completed voice text stayed in both authoritative history and the active-call preview. Hand off only after history publication, scoped to the exact turn and text. Retain pending/failed previews, fence older receipts from newer turns, and prevent repeated final events from resurrecting a published card. The real-hook harness renders the production voice page for both session and local-context paths.

EMBED-YOUTUBE-153: Mobile session transcript embeds must not suppress YouTube's required HTTP referrer. After consent, use strict-origin-when-cross-origin for YouTube only; retain other providers' no-referrer policy and existing sandbox. Render the actual Transcript in regression tests, not just the URL detector.

REVIEW-HERE: required Hermes and Support approvals use a top-layer review over the current screen, not navigation to pet/Support. Long editable text grows before scrolling, with compact actions. Dialog toggle triggers measurement after showModal; safe-inset assertions wait for the actual viewport resize rather than reading stale portrait geometry.

VOICE-REVIEW-CARD: review state is visible, editable, and app-owned. Only explicit card buttons send or cancel. Speech remains ordinary conversation and has no review mutation path. The action row must not stretch into the flex-allocated review height. Rolling provider context preserves instructions and exposes scoped complete-record voice history reads.

VOICE-CAPACITY: initial source evidence is negotiated separately from standing instructions. The real hook must deliver all lossless frames in order before requesting the greeting. Explicit microphone selection stays strict, but the System default alias follows changing hardware and must not be compared to a concrete Bluetooth device ID. Capacity errors must stop rather than retry unchanged payloads.

VOICE-NOTEBOOK: negotiated recall/save/forget operations use the separate host voice notebook; legacy read_voice_memory keeps its older host contract. Saves retain the original attached target, revision and exact source fields, and never send an agent prompt or rebuild the active prompt. The refresh harness counter lives outside React's replaceable fixture facade so renders cannot erase the test witness.

SUPPORT-REFRESH: the real voice hook must route get_context_snapshot to the attached application, publish actual read records in context preview, and never claim that replaying identity through the session RPC refreshed Support. Initial Support voice requires an authenticated queue or whole-thread read before microphone/token startup.

Support voice default index reads now follow the current visible filter and query on every call. Explicit filters retain their own scope. The regression executes the adapter across a live filter change rather than snapshotting instruction text.

Worker and page-awareness hook checks require quiet append-only UI metadata without a new voice connection or retargeting; worker steering must send only the edited approved text to the attached parent's owned worker. The ownership assertion uses the real snapshot field attachedContextId, not a nonexistent attachedSessionId.
UI-009 now records which restoration phase failed and a private screenshot. An intermittent post-rotation cleanup timeout must remain attributable; a passing rerun does not erase the failed receipt.

UI-011 must query the actual accessible name Start live voice, not the visible caption Live voice. Physical landscape checks cover the internal Chat and voice regions, not merely the page boundary: the composer must stay attached below the transcript, voice controls must sit above the transcript, and no oversized empty composer rail may pass. The landscape identity rail must also render the complete machine and profile text rather than collapsing to unlabeled dots. Preserve visibility and native Back assertions; no live call is started.

ADB-DISCOVERY: discover only the explicitly authorized host, prefer one connected endpoint, never confuse a pairing port with a connect port, and report ambiguity or missing transport without port scans, server resets, or automatic trust.

UI-011 now records the exact fixed phase label and a private failure screenshot after a physical rotation check timed out. This changes diagnostics only, not acceptance. Transport loss still fails; original rotation settings must be restored.

HEADER-VOICE-SHORTCUT: the idle top-level wake/voice shortcut duplicated controls already available in session Options and stole the width needed by machine/profile identity. Remove it from the header. Keep the in-call microphone control because it directly controls an active audio lease.

HOOK-BILLING and realtimeUsage tests: response usage must be counted once even when playback is cancelled, persist across reconnect, reset on a fresh call, and label missing pricing/transcription honestly. Voice cost stays reachable with conversation text hidden.

The main Voice shortcut opens the conversation without opening settings or starting a call. Explicit settings stay in Options and on the voice page. Rotation/Back checks exercise that separate navigation, and the installed UI check opens settings from inside the page.

Operator rejected the half-height voice rail. VOICE-PAGE-ROTATE now requires a dedicated whole-viewport page across rotation and keyboard sizes, preserving draft/call state and restoring underlying session interaction on Back. PET-UI-HIDE must keep page geometry stable instead of shrinking a sheet.
Superseded rail experiment: fixtures retain actual shell ancestry, but voice is now a dedicated page. Native cutout/navigation insets must survive short landscape viewports.

Installed visibility was insufficient: settings and approvals must intersect the sidechat scroll viewport after history hydration. Classify automation failures without logging private selectors or page content.

Cold Vite compilation is navigation setup, not voice latency; allow the first transcript fixture a separate 60-second setup budget while preserving 30-second later navigation and five-second behavioral guards.
Synthetic media mocks are configurable because live fixture edits otherwise fail HMR with Cannot redefine property; this is not a native microphone fix.
ADB reconnect can remove the task forward before cleanup. Confirmed absence satisfies cleanup, but failed UI restoration remains a failed check.

checks.name: Support queue prioritizes tickets and keeps troubleshooting separate
checks.reason: Operator rejected compressed Support controls and background records ahead of tickets. Test real SupportOpsView with long titles and40 synthetic tasks in portrait, landscape, light and dark. Queue contains search, filters and tickets, not task history, settings or overview statistics. Activity is explicitly opened, with recent history and technical details collapsed. This replaces the old pixel-shrink check while preserving safe queueing and cancellation.

checks.name: Sessions search, sort, live target and compact support with safe capability controls
checks.reason: Run scripts/qa/mobile-polish.mjs with synthetic components and production Desktop tokens. Keep existing session, capability and context checks. Operator rejected the Support-only cramped density and intrusive activity. Its check now requires readable titles/controls, tickets near the top and no task activity in Queue. Other component checks are unchanged.

checks.name: Bounded background audio ownership and connection recovery
checks.reason: Shared speech queue retains mediaPlayback across synthesis and clip gaps. Native clip lease follows preparation, pause, resume and completion, including failure and teardown. MediaPlayer uses playback-scoped wake mode and never requests TTS focus. Native active playback may reconnect while locked, but idle UI does not. Synthetic ownership tests are not physical lock-screen proof.

checks.name: Last settings row stays above Android navigation
checks.reason: Execute production ControlPanel and CSS in the actual shell ancestry. Scroll to the final collapsed Advanced row and compare pane/row bounds with the simulated native navigation boundary. Verify composer and Reader do not count the inset twice, including zero inset with the keyboard open.

checks.name: Hermes Mobile renders Hermes Desktop's design system on a phone
checks.reason: Appearance is Desktop's vendored theme engine and tokens (client/src/vendor/desktop, regenerated by scripts/desktop-theme/sync.mjs) plus area skins in client/src/skin. Shell is Desktop's window folded onto a phone: one 40px titlebar (sidebar toggle, pane title, pane actions), Desktop sidebar as a portrait drawer and pinned landscape rail (replaces the bottom tab bar), in-flow notices that never cover controls, Desktop composer (input over a mic/voice-mode/send toolbar, workspace on its status line), Tabler icons. Desktop literal sizes: 13px body and conversation text, 12px/28px controls, 2.5px control radii. Keyboard-open state (<html data-keyboard>) removes static chrome. Device acceptance: portrait, keyboard open, landscape and landscape keyboard in light and dark; Escape, outside tap and rotation close Session options; typing stays responsive with a long transcript.

checks.name: Synthesized speech does not seize other apps' audio focus
checks.reason: Bypass WebView focus handling for every shared TTS consumer without changing browser media or live communication routes. Tests execute native selection and ownership lifecycle, not source matching. Device acceptance must verify other media keeps playing at its original volume through pet speech, response Listen, Reader, Support, pause/resume and cancellation.

checks.name: Safe shared math rendering and contained mobile layout
checks.reason: Execute the shared Markdown renderer for dollar and LaTeX delimiters, malformed input, code literals, protected URLs, streaming completion and unsafe commands. Check 360x740, 740x360 and 320x480 geometry with locally loaded math fonts.

checks.name: Installed clients receive new host questions safely
checks.reason: Core migrated questions from events to server requests. The authenticated plugin socket translates v1 cards and responses, replays pending questions once, and rejects cross-session, duplicate, cancelled or ambiguous approvals. An old ID-less approval never guesses between overlapping requests. No answer or credential value is journaled.

checks.name: Visible card is the only approval authority
checks.reason: VOICE-APPROVAL-LOOP: Replaced caption extraction, filler filters, quiet-period staging and opaque client delegation with the documented Live Responses tool loop. Collect complete function items through response.completed, return all function outputs, then one response.create. A structured draft is complete and editable. expectedDraft prevents stale or cross-target revisions, including while submitting or after cancel/send. User captions never approve or overwrite. Realtime retains its separate transport. Existing helper-only parser tests were testing the wrong authority and are replaced by real-hook structured-event checks.

checks.name: One coherent user-started GPT-Live call
checks.reason: Atomic server startup contains bounded whole historical records and an explicit new-call boundary. No greeting, saved transcript replay, or repeated UI/session context appends are generated by the client. Do not conceal model inference with a mute gate. Interleaved captions do not split every spoken sentence into a completed turn. Single-flight startup and visible disconnect failure remain. Real silence and speech behavior require hardware/provider acceptance.

checks.name: Concise voice in both modes
checks.reason: Live uses server-created WebRTC with a separate Responses reasoning backend and the full existing history, memory, and draft tool catalog. Frontend and backend prompts have separate roles. On-demand readers carry full tool results through response.item.create, not 500-token commentary snippets. Small application receipts retain bounded Live append delivery. Realtime defaults remain unchanged.

checks.name: Integrated profile and scheduled work controls
checks.reason: Profile selection and cron parity must live inside the existing collapsed Controls section system. Scheduled work exposes real profile-scoped running state, Run now, history, output and lifecycle actions without a duplicate top-level panel.

checks.name: Current approval and result evidence
checks.reason: Old pending-review receipts were the only explicit review state in read results. Return current session-scoped pending review and last submission, plus the latest whole assistant message when supplied by the host. A previous acceptance never approves a new draft or proves completion.

checks.name: Honest attached-session context state
checks.reason: The voice page must not present a bounded attached-session preview as fully loaded data. Show attachment, Preview or Full transcript with message coverage, the authoritative last-observed timestamp plus freshness, and whether scoped saved voice memory exists. Keep those facts visible and contained across portrait, landscape, and keyboard-height layouts.

checks.name: One card per completed voice turn
checks.reason: Saved history and live preview previously displayed the same completed reply. Six production-hook/page cases cover successful, pending, failed and history-less receipts, repeated or late finals, identical next-turn wording, and local-context history.

checks.name: Physical Chat and voice landscape
checks.reason: Operator reported a blank composer rail and broken landscape voice. Verify actual Android rotation, contained internal Chat and voice geometry, compact bottom composers, full-width transcript ownership and native Back. Restore the original rotation settings and never start a call.

checks.name: Centered square header actions
checks.reason: Refresh and Close controls must use fixed square hit boxes and centered theme-matched SVG strokes instead of font glyphs whose baselines drift.

checks.name: Private failure classification
checks.reason: A real attached-context failure and generic provider error events had no actionable reason. Log only fixed allowlisted failure labels and duration, never raw provider errors, private messages or tool arguments. Unknown failures stay unknown.

checks.name: Audio floor, output route and media owner
checks.reason: Android WebRTC selected the call receiver because live voice retained microphone ownership without owning the communication output. A native lease now preserves an already active headset, otherwise selects speakerphone even when dormant Bluetooth devices are available, reasserts after WebRTC route changes, and restores Android audio state after the final lease. Late item IDs retain their speech epoch, old ASR cannot clear newer playback, and each claimed output buffer must show inbound media progress or receive one bounded stream rebind before a visible failure.

checks.name: One recognizer with three routes
checks.reason: Editable connection-scoped live voice phrase releases native wake capture before Realtime, without transcription or agent send.

checks.name: Continuous scoped conversation
checks.reason: Track discussed targets and identities across turns. Exact Support state requires an exact read; failed, stale, or warning-bearing evidence is labeled and cannot be silently replaced with queue-index guesses. Interrupted reads finish their function output without resuming obsolete speech.

checks.name: Whole-record attached context
checks.reason: Initial snapshots select complete messages and tools. Rolling updates retain every changed row. Exact Support reads gather all stable-revision pages and fail instead of returning partial context.

checks.name: Review on the current page
checks.reason: Review-required requests open over the current page without pet navigation. Compact actions and an expanding editor use the viewport; Later preserves the draft, and Back closes only the review. Hide text never hides approvals or controls.

checks.name: User-owned webpage opening
checks.reason: A voice tool offers the exact validated HTTP address without opening a page or falsely reporting success. Only a deliberate user click opens it.

checks.name: Lossless bounded tool transport
checks.reason: Complete tool results can exceed WebRTC message sizes. Transport frames retain every character and one function completion; webpage routing is exercised through the actual hook.

checks.name: Recover pre-transport startup
checks.reason: A saved host health 502 during Desktop restart previously cleared connection intent before normal reconnect existed. Bound health retries, preserve auth gates, and cancel on disconnect or host replacement.

checks.name: Dedicated voice page
checks.reason: Portrait, landscape and keyboard-sized controls stay contained with native safe insets. Hide text preserves controls and geometry. Back restores the session without ending voice or losing drafts.

checks.name: Realtime owns pet audio
checks.reason: Pending commentary and clicks must not speak over live voice; ending voice restores unchanged preferences.

checks.name: Viewport containment
checks.reason: Prevent horizontal overflow and off-screen composer after layout or inset changes. Automatic pet roaming must stay above the composer while manual dragging retains the full viewport.

checks.name: Compact readable identity header
checks.reason: Mic and connection state must not overlap the logo or create another portrait row. The redundant idle wake/voice shortcut stays out of the header, while the direct in-call microphone remains. Status controls use matched themed rounded-square geometry, machine and profile stay independently readable in both orientations, and header glyphs are centered SVGs instead of font characters.

checks.name: Single-line session title
checks.reason: Long session titles must not consume the transcript viewport.

checks.name: Readable options
checks.reason: Wake, Replies, and During turn belong in Options with complete values and usable targets, not a permanent row.

checks.name: Cycle and restore safe preferences
checks.reason: Replies and steering should round-trip without native selector dialogs; live wake transitions are deliberately excluded.

checks.name: Composer action placement
checks.reason: Running turns need enabled Stop in the Send slot, with follow-up Send inline rather than another row.

checks.name: Work placement
checks.reason: Only current work may appear, directly above the composer. An absent Work card is not proof of its active layout.

checks.name: New runtime exceptions
checks.reason: Catch new page exceptions and known early-DOM framework errors separately without recording conversation data.

checks.name: Restore test state
checks.reason: A smoke test must not leave preferences or menu visibility changed.

checks.name: Settings viewport ownership
checks.reason: The installed app opened settings then autoscrolled them away behind old history. Check actual scroll-viewport containment without starting voice or changing preferences.

checks.name: New session removes old transcript DOM
checks.reason: The phone showed old scrollable tool cards above the new draft even though the new model turn had zero history. Inject a synthetic React-unowned card, tap New twice, require an empty main transcript, and restore the original session without sending a prompt. Durable tool rows also need unique stable keys when a provider reuses a call ID.

manual.reason: Back to chat returns to the selected live session without New or resume. Test compact sessions search/views/sort and Support controls. Context meter exposes current used/free tokens and actual Hermes compression threshold, with estimated provenance when needed. Full host terminal and new connector authorization/catalog/account selection remain unimplemented.

Lock the phone during Reader, pet, response Listen and Support TTS. Playback must continue across several segments and resume networking only for active native audio when needed. Verify Pause/Stop releases media playback ownership, live voice retains its separate microphone lease, and no idle playback lease remains after completion. No paid call or active-session interruption merely for smoke testing.

After data-preserving APK replacement, play music or a podcast in another app. Pet, response Listen, Reader and Support TTS must mix without pausing or ducking it. Verify pause/resume, Stop, headset routing and background cleanup. Do not interrupt an active agent session for this check.
Actual speech after greeting; microphone mute/unmute; no silent active call.
Barge-in, cough/noise, stop-speaking silence, and recovery after interruption.
Screen-off/background/reconnect audio and Support-thread context continuity.
Authorized real turn: immediate Stop, current Work, inline steering, and scroll stability.
